items.summary: An FBI advisory says criminals and APT groups increasingly use the ARTEX AI framework to automate intrusions at machine speed, compressing defender response windows.

items.title: 2026-018: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP
items.summary: CERT-EU advisory on two critical PHP flaws enabling unauthenticated remote code execution, fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. PoCs are circulating, raising exploitation risk.

items.title: 2026-019: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
items.summary: CERT-EU warns of a critical GitLab CE/EE flaw allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution on the server; patch internet-facing instances first and hunt for compromise.

items.title: 2026-020: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
items.summary: Citrix published fixes for 28 memory flaws in NetScaler ADC and Gateway; CVE-2026-120868 affects all deployments including default configurations, with DoS and unpredictable behaviour impact. No known exploitation yet.

items.title: Oracle reveals fix-this-ASAP-grade Java4Shell bug that allows attacks on many third-party apps
items.summary: Oracle issued an urgent fix for the Java4Shell flaw that lets attackers crash the JVM or achieve unauthenticated RCE in many third-party applications.

items.summary: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) enables pre-auth RCE in Jira, Jenkins, Keycloak and other apps on Java 17.0.6+ running on x86-64 CPUs with AVX-512 VBMI support.

items.title: Attackers Used Optimizely to A/B Test Malware on Top Websites
items.summary: Krebs reports attackers abused Optimizely to A/B test malware against visitors of at least 178 major sites including BBC, CNN, Equifax, Ledger and Zoom, worsened by weak third-party content controls.

items.title: CVE-2026-114938: Critical vulnerability in OpenJDK JAVA

items.title: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
items.summary: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT…

items.title: Format string flaw in OwnTracks Recorder
items.summary: OwnTracks Recorder versions before 1.0.5 mishandle formatting of a stored tracking identifier in response output. An unauthenticated attacker who can submit location data may be able to trigger code execution when affected data is returned.
items.mitigation: Upgrade OwnTracks Recorder to version 1.0.5 or later. Until upgraded, restrict untrusted access to location-ingestion and API endpoints.

items.title: Authentication bypass in dataelement BISHENG
items.summary: BISHENG versions before 3.0.0 use a hard-coded default JWT secret in AuthJwt. An unauthenticated remote attacker can impersonate an administrator and access administrative functions if the affected authentication configuration is exposed.
items.mitigation: Upgrade BISHENG to version 3.0.0 or later. Restrict access to affected BISHENG instances until the upgrade is complete.
